parts.frozen_text_quoted: one instrument term drawn from the frozen instrument vocabulary - the terms naming binary event contracts, event derivatives, prediction markets, or the named venues
parts.what_was_done: weather derivative / economic derivatives / macroeconomic derivatives placed in the instrument slot
parts.condition_1: the family is itself an event-derivative family (payoff contingent on a verifiable event) - economic derivatives and macroeconomic derivatives enter here
parts.condition_2: the term names a section 2.2 counterparty leg - weather derivative enters HERE and NOT on condition 1, because an HDD/CDD swap is index-linked, not binary
parts.does_not_license: any financial-instrument noun; a term naming neither an event-contingent payoff family nor a 2.2 counterparty leg stays outside the slot

parts.frozen_text_quoted: one strategy term drawn from the frozen strategy vocabulary - arbitrage, coherence, mispricing, market making, quoting, inventory, spread, execution, hedging, forecasting-driven trading

parts.does_not_license: an agent-class term whose area is not named in the section 3.4 seed list

parts.frozen_text_quoted: Category or subject narrowing is applied only where the unrestricted phrase returns predominantly out-of-domain records ... each narrowing is recorded in the query table with the reason.
parts.what_was_done: ks-crossref-14 set query.container-title=SSRN; a container restriction is neither a category nor a subject narrowing
parts.distinction_that_binds: a container restriction is admissible ONLY where it REACHES an otherwise-unreachable source, NEVER where it EXCLUDES records that would otherwise be retrieved
parts.why_it_reaches: SSRN's own search interface returned HTTP 403 unauthenticated (ks-ssrn-01); the restriction adds a retrieval path and removes none

withdrawal_rule: A reviewer rejecting any part may withdraw exactly the records tagged with that part's reached_via value, and no others.

decided_by: lead session, on audit finding SCOPE-1-7 (scope-auditor, round 1)
execution_stage: POST-EXECUTION and declared as such per section 10. The 1,465 G-dispositions were assigned before this contradiction was adjudicated. This is a WEAKER amendment than M1. No record moves, no count moves, no eligibility is decided.

contradiction.section_4_2: every deduplicated record receives exactly ONE stage-1 disposition, enumerated as include / exclude-with-Y-code / promote
contradiction.section_4_4: creates capacity codes G1 and G2, which are none of the three, and states a capacity gap is NOT a criterion failure and NOT an eligibility determination
contradiction.scale: 1,465 of 1,574 screened records (93% of the delivered flow) took the path 4.2 does not enumerate

ruling: A G-code is a FOURTH stage-1 outcome. Section 4.2's 'exactly one disposition' is read as conditional on assessment capacity. Arithmetic unchanged: G-rows sit inside n_excluded so the 4.5 identities close, and are reported decomposed as n_excluded == Y-rows + G-rows (10 + 1465 = 1475).
